h1: Customer segmentation for emails and texts
overview: One message rarely suits everyone. We build the groups that let you send the right one: new subscribers, first-time buyers, repeat buyers, big spenders, people who only look at one collection, and people who stopped opening. We create them inside your own tool using real order and activity data, then explain what each group is for and give you a sending suggestion for every one.

faq: How much data do I need for segments?
A few hundred contacts and some order history is enough to start. With a smaller list, we build fewer, broader groups, because tiny segments give you too little to send to.
Will segments update on their own?
Yes. We build dynamic segments, so people move in and out as they buy or go quiet. We test the rules with sample customers, so you can see them behave correctly.
Do you use personal data in a way that is safe?
We use only data you already collected through your store and forms, and respect consent. We never build segments based on sensitive traits, and we do not move data outside your own tools.
Which tools can you build segments in?
Klaviyo, Mailchimp, Omnisend, Brevo and similar tools. Segments are easiest in Klaviyo, and we tell you if your plan limits what can be done.
